column1: # The checks of shell/keyword-kinds.nsh: hii keyword set of a DATE, a TIME and an ORDERED_LIST
# through the Keyword Handler, which writes each VALUE as given (UEFI 2.11 §35.3.2), and refusals
# before any call, which dmpstore shows wrote nothing. See check-shell-log.sh.
# TerminalDxe prints a character outside ASCII as "?" unless the serial terminal is VT-UTF8, so
# the checks of texts that cite "§" compare them with "?" in its place.
# KindStore as publish-hiidb creates it: 2024-03-31 at byte 0, 12:34:56 at byte 4, the items 1, 2
# and 3 at byte 8, and the EFI_HII_REF of QuestionId 4 and FormId 1 at byte 12
# the DATE suppresses its year: a VALUE that keeps 2024 sets 2024-04-01

column3: (.error_message | gsub("§"; "?")) == "keyword KindDate: VALUE=010407e9 of question \"Kind date\": the year of this DATE is suppressed (UEFI 2.11 ?33.2.5.4.6), and set writes it as 2024, not 2025"

column1: # the TIME suppresses its second: a VALUE that keeps 56 sets 13:00:56

column3: .error_message == "keyword KindTime: VALUE=382218 of question \"Kind time\": hour 24 is outside 0 to 23"

column1: # the ORDERED_LIST, last container first: the items 3, 2 and 1

column3: (.error_message | gsub("§"; "?")) == "keyword KindList: VALUE=010003 of question \"Kind list\": cannot set question \"Kind list\": a container after an empty one holds a value, where set writes 0 after the last item (UEFI 2.11 ?33.3.8.3.53)"
.error_message == "keyword KindList: VALUE=000101 of question \"Kind list\": cannot set question \"Kind list\": the ORDERED_LIST takes each option once (EFI_IFR_UNIQUE_SET): \"First\" is given twice"

column1: # set does not write the EFI_HII_REF of a REF, which keyword set refuses with set's error

column3: (.error_message | gsub("§"; "?")) == "keyword KindRef: cannot set question \"Kind ref\": set does not write the EFI_HII_REF of a cross-reference question, the target of its link (UEFI 2.11 ?33.2.5.4.10)"
